experiment.title: Foam half-life of 12 mM SDS solution by sparging
experiment.goal:
Use the foam rig foam_1 to determine the foam half-life (min) of a 12 mM aqueous sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) solution.
sds_stock is 40.0 mM aqueous SDS and water is deionized water. Prepare 60 mL of 12 mM SDS in the foam column col_1 (18 mL stock + 42 mL water),
put col_1 on foam_1, sparge at 300 mL/min for 30 s with sparge to generate foam, then record continuously with record (long enough for the foam height to fall below half its initial value),
and read foam_1.half_life (seconds). Half-life = the time for the foam height to fall to half its value when sparging stopped.
When done, submit with submit_result: quantity = "foam_half_life", unit = "min".
